How this website handles your information.

This notice describes the website only. The practice's HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices, which covers your dental records, is a separate document and should be reviewed and published by the practice.
These pages are static. They set no cookies of their own, run no analytics and build no profile of you.

Appointment requests and virtual-consultation forms on this site are hosted by third-party providers on behalf of the practice. What you type into them is sent to Mason Park Dental of Katy and handled under that provider's own terms. Online booking opens the practice's scheduling provider in a new tab.
The map on our contact pages is served by Google Maps, which may set its own cookies once it loads. It is only loaded when you scroll to it.
Questions about your information, or a request to have it removed, can go to the practice directly on
or at 21830 Kingsland Blvd #104A, Katy, TX 77450.
